coverage_note: Indiana's public-sector bargaining statute in the sources captured is the teacher law, IC 20-29 (Collective Bargaining for Teachers), from the 2026 edition of the Indiana Code. No statute for state or local government employees was captured.

who_may_bargain.value: Full-time certificated employees of a school employer, excluding supervisors, confidential employees, employees performing security work, noncertificated employees and adjunct teachers holding IC 20-28-5-27 permits; unlicensed career and technical education instructors employed under IC 20-28-5-22.1 are treated as teachers for bargaining
who_may_bargain.quote: "School employee" means a full-time certificated person in the employment of the school employer. A school employee is considered full time even though the employee does not work during school vacation periods and accordingly works less than a full year. The term does not include: (1) supervisors; (2) confidential employees; (3) employees performing security work; (4) noncertificated employees; and (5) adjunct teachers who hold permits issued under IC 20-28-5-27 .
